items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1971-04-20
items.q: Poor T-Boy is laid out on the floor.

ctx.x: On the St. Joe. A big boat. And the last time we made that trip, across that Michigan Lake, that boat cracked us like firecrackers. It was a big boat. And they had a whole well of blue jackets on there. Sailors. Mm-hmm. And you know all them sailors were sick? Mm-hmm. Poor T-Boy is laid out on the floor. Ha, ha, ha. And I'm walking up there laughing at them people. Never did worry of me at all.
